fusions.name: Gutter Bite
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 4% easier to wound for 3 seconds, with a 25% chance of leaving the target [Diseased] for 6 seconds, healing it less.

fusions.name: Swarm Rush
fusions.desc: Hits every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 10 damage to each. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Scrounged Strength
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Last Off the Ship
fusions.desc: When your health runs out, you regain 8 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 120 seconds.
